description: This file defines the DataValidation class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing constants and methods to configure data validation rules for spreadsheet cells.

classes.name: PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\DataValidation
classes.description: Class encapsulating data validation properties and methods for spreadsheet cells, including validation types, error styles, operators, and configuration options.

methods.name: getFormula1
methods.description: Returns the first formula associated with the data validation rule.

methods.name: setFormula1
methods.description: Sets the first formula for the data validation rule.

methods.name: getFormula2
methods.description: Returns the second formula associated with the data validation rule.

methods.name: setFormula2
methods.description: Sets the second formula for the data validation rule.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the validation type (e.g., list, date, decimal).

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the validation type.

methods.name: getErrorStyle
methods.description: Returns the style of error displayed when validation fails.

methods.name: setErrorStyle
methods.description: Sets the error style.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator used in validation (e.g., between, equal).

methods.name: setOperator
methods.description: Sets the validation operator.

methods.name: getAllowBlank
methods.description: Returns whether blank entries are allowed.

methods.name: setAllowBlank
methods.description: Sets whether to allow blank entries.

methods.name: getShowDropDown
methods.description: Returns whether to show a drop-down list for user selection.

methods.name: setShowDropDown
methods.description: Sets whether to show a drop-down list.

methods.name: getShowInputMessage
methods.description: Returns whether the input message is shown when cell is selected.

methods.name: setShowInputMessage
methods.description: Sets whether to display the input message.

methods.name: getShowErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns whether an error message is shown on validation failure.

methods.name: setShowErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets whether to display the error message.

methods.name: getErrorTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the error message.

methods.name: setErrorTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the error message.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error message.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets the error message.

methods.name: getPromptTitle
methods.description: Returns the prompt title.

methods.name: setPromptTitle
methods.description: Sets the prompt title.

methods.name: getPrompt
methods.description: Returns the prompt message.

methods.name: setPrompt
methods.description: Sets the prompt message.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the current validation configuration.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the DataValidation object.

methods.name: getSqref
methods.description: Returns the cell reference(s) the validation applies to.

methods.name: setSqref
methods.description: Sets the cell reference(s) for validation.
